claim: Current projections put AI-optimized servers at roughly 35-44% of total data-centre power by 2030, making AI the largest single category but still not the majority of all data-centre demand.
comparisonContext: This keeps the site from implying that all data-centre growth is AI-only growth while still showing that AI becomes the largest single slice.
scopeNote: The lower end is inferred from IEA accelerated-server projections; the 44% high end depends on proprietary Gartner-style estimates that are not publicly verifiable.
